description: Report cites evidence from three different sources: a transaction (T1-001), a relationship-graph edge (R1), and a watchlist entity (WATCHLIST1) -- exactly the kind of cross-source grounding the multi-source case architecture (task-007) is meant to support.
report_text: N100 sent funds to M201 (T1-001), an edge confirmed in the relationship graph (R1), and M301 is independently corroborated by a prior watchlist flag (WATCHLIST1).
flag: SCOPE FINDING (about the LEGACY, transaction-only overload this fixture and TraceabilityValidationTests exercise): AmlAgent.Evidence.EvidenceScoring.ExtractCitedTxnIds uses the fixed regex \bT[123]-\d{3}\b, which only recognises transaction-id-shaped tokens. Called with ONLY a flat set of transaction ids (the ComputeTraceability(string, IReadOnlySet<string>, IReadOnlySet<string>?) overload), the relationship id 'R1' and the watchlist entity id 'WATCHLIST1' in this report are invisible to cited_total/cited_distinct/grounded/fabricated_citations -- despite the report genuinely citing them as supporting evidence. This overload is kept exactly as-is deliberately, for backward compatibility with existing callers (JudgeAgent.cs's current grounding-file-based scoring), so this fixture's expected values below remain correct and this is NOT a bug in that code path. RESOLVED AT THE LIBRARY LEVEL: AmlAgent.Evidence.EvidenceReference plus the new ComputeTraceability(string, IReadOnlyCollection<EvidenceReference>, IReadOnlyCollection<EvidenceReference>?) overload (see docs/evidence-traceability-framework.md and tests/AmlAgent.Tests/EvidenceReferenceScoringTests.cs) now correctly recognises citations to ANY evidence type -- relationship, SAR, watchlist, entity, account, etc -- via known-id token matching against the case's actual evidence universe (AmlAgent.Adapters.Canonical.CanonicalAmlCaseEvidenceExtensions.ToEvidenceReferences), rather than a fixed shape regex. Fabrication detection for non-transaction-shaped ids remains a real, still-open gap (there is no universal id shape to pattern-match against arbitrary evidence types) -- see the new API's own doc comments. RESOLVED AT THE LIVE-JUDGE LEVEL TOO: agents/csharp-sk/Agent/JudgeAgent.cs now detects case-definition.json staged into the workspace (task-007 has one; task-006 and every task that predates this feature does not) and, when present, reloads it via CaseLoader/AdapterRegistry to score against the full ToEvidenceReferences() universe -- verified against the real task-007 case data end-to-end (case-definition.json -> CaseLoader -> ToEvidenceReferences -> ComputeTraceability correctly recognised R1/R6/WATCHLIST1 citations and still flagged a shape-fabricated transaction id). Tasks without case-definition.json are unaffected -- they still take this fixture's legacy overload path exactly as before.
